verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B300 / DGX B300 is a physical GPU server that the buyer installs in their own racks. Choosing a storage region or residency setting is a hosted-service axis that does not apply to on-premises hardware. The evidence describes hardware specs only, such as self-encrypting NVMe drives and the BMC, and shows no shipped region-selection capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
